en: A black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop complex with a tall, ornate baroque tower rising from a multi‑storey castle or monastery building. The structure has steep tiled roofs with dormer windows and is surrounded by dense forested hills. Smaller houses with gabled roofs lie below the main complex in a valley town. The overall scene is rural and Central‑European in character. No visible text appears on the image.
